newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania net average wage 0.5 pct down in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Romania net average wage 0.5 pct down in Sept.

text.p: The average net wage in Romania dropped slightly in September to 341,361 lei, a 0.5 percent fall from August, but rose by 48.7 percent from last September, National Statistics Board (CNS) data showed.
The CNS said purchasing power slipped by 2.8 percent in September from the previous month and was 2.3 percent up from September 1995.
September's purchasing power was 29 percent down from October 1990.
Employees in the banking sector had the highest net wage of 710,721 lei on an average in September, when workers in the health and social security sectors had the lowest pay -- 255,574 lei.
Romania employed 5.8 million people at end-September, some 23,000 less than the previous month.
